headings.usage: All H1-H3 headings. Use tracking-tight for H1.

body.usage: All body text, UI elements, and small headings (H4-H6).

StateSelector.style: Large, prominent, centered on Hero. Use 'Command' component logic.
StateSelector.interaction: Searchable dropdown with clear active states.

StepCard.style: Clean white card with subtle border. Hover: lift + shadow-lg. Status indicator (icon) top right.
StepCard.content: Step number, Title, Description, Action Button.

ResourceDownload.style: Compact, horizontal layout. Icon (PDF) left, Text middle, Download Icon right.

ProgressBar.style: Thick (h-4), rounded-full. Track: bg-slate-100. Indicator: bg-secondary (Gold).

hero_bg.usage: Hero section background or side image

instructions_to_main_agent: THEME SETUP: Ensure Tailwind config extends font family: 'sans': ['DM Sans', ...], 'serif': ['Libre Baskerville', ...]
NO GRADIENTS: Use solid colors for backgrounds. Use texture (noise) if needed for depth, but keep it clean for this educational app.
ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure Blue/Gold contrast ratios are met. Use darker Gold (#B45309) for text, lighter Gold (#FEF3C7) for backgrounds.
STATE SELECTOR: This is the core feature. Make it the 'Hero' interaction. Don't hide it.
CONTENT: Use 'Lorem Ipsum' for detailed legal text but keep headings realistic (e.g., 'Step 1: NPI Number').
TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards).
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters where appropriate (e.g., sticky nav).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
